title: Tonnato Sauce
description: Chef John's recipe for tonnato sauce combines tuna and anchovies with mayonnaise and garlic to produce a versatile and easy spread or dip.
ingredients: 1 (7 ounce) jar olive oil-packed tuna, oil reserved
0.25 cup extra-virgin olive oil, or more to taste
3 tablespoons lemon juice, or more to taste
1 clove garlic, minced, or more to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Blend tuna with reserved oil, mayonnaise, anchovies, olive oil, lemon juice, capers, and garlic together in a blender until completely smooth. Season with cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.

video.description: In this video, Chef John makes a flavorful sauce out of oil-packed tuna and anchovy fillets. The two get blended together with mayonnaise, lemon juice, olive oil, capers and garlic into a smooth, decadent sauce. Get Chef John's recipe for [Tonnato Sauce](http://allrecipes.com/Recipe/Tonnato-Sauce/Detail.aspx?src=VD_Summary). At the end of the video, Chef John will show his favorite ways to use the sauce. _[See more Chef John videos >>](http://allrecipes.com/videos/16478/food-wishes/main.aspx?src=VD_Summary)_
